headline: Israel rejects Trump's 15-point plan for Gaza, Netanyahu says

script: Israel says it rejects Donald Trump's fifteen-point plan for Gaza. Benjamin Netanyahu says Israeli forces will not leave until Hamas is genuinely disarmed, leaving negotiations at an impasse.
